stem: Which sentence best explains why Joubert was able to provide the care Jessica needed?

options.label: F
options.text: He had nursed many orphaned animals back to health.

options.label: G
options.text: He knew the baby hippo was very young and weak.

options.label: H
options.text: He carried the 26-pound animal into his house and named her Jessica.

options.label: J
options.text: He mixed egg yolks and cream and fed it to Jessica from a bottle.
